name: journal-atlas
description: Journal Atlas marketplace — a single-plugin marketplace exposing the journal-atlas skill (academic journal fit assessment) for /plugin marketplace add Zaious/journal-atlas installs.

plugins.name: journal-atlas
plugins.description: Choose where to submit a paper from cited soft metadata (reviewer culture, word limits, fees, AI policy), not model recall. Recommend, compare, query and plan rejection fallbacks over 399 venue profiles; scores come from code and show their evidence coverage. A second skill turns your experience with a journal into a pull request. Eight /ja-* commands.
